_comment: Film 31 Lyria 3.5 prompts (google/lyria-3.5, 2026-11-17). One track per chapter; chapters = sections of timing.json (H,1 | 2,3 | M,4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8,A2 + end screen). M5 (chapter 7) was declined by Lyria's content filter: chapter 7 reuses M1 from 15 s (music/cues.json). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f31/audio/music, not in the repo.
style: Instrumental underscore, calm and mysterious (night foundry: machines keep building while people sleep): soft mechanical pulse of muted plucks, low drones, sparse felt piano, glassy shimmer, distant wordless choir pad. No drums, no vocals, no melody hook, not epic, not uplifting. Very quiet, narrow dynamic range, made to sit under a voice.

M0.mood: mysterious, slightly uneasy: distant loom-like pulse, warm drone, felt piano, glass shimmer

M1.mood: curious and patient: rising felt-piano/glass arpeggio fragments, pulse ~66 bpm like footsteps on rungs

M2.mood: 10 s calm warmth, then analytical quiet tension: ticking plucks, low cello drone

M3.mood: dark, pensive, time compressing: heartbeat-like low pulse, low strings, glass/choir pads

M4.mood: grave, suspended: low drone, single sparse piano note, choir pad swelling

M5.mood: DECLINED by the Lyria content filter, replaced by M1 @15 s

M6.mood: calm, quietly hopeful: last slow felt-piano figure, pulse fades, long warm decaying chord
